reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x0048F120 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/fx/0048F120-SetScreenMode.cpp at sha256 65fec34526dd57d52c8ceb42d1f852749af375e41ffa480ed2f0bc8120a60324 (recorded implementation.signature: int __cdecl FX_FireBallUpdate_23(int context);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.
